en: Sepia-toned photograph of a large two‑story neoclassical building seen from the front, with evenly spaced arched windows on both floors, three prominent arched doorways at the center, a balcony with balustrade above the entrance, and a flat roof with decorative cornice. The building faces an open cobblestone square, partially framed by tree branches in the foreground. A small handwritten red number appears in the upper right corner of the image.
